text_by_language.en: IMD Guwahati has issued forecast for Light Thunderstorms with light to moderate rain which is very likely to occur at isolated places over Charaideo, Dhemaji, Dibrugarh, Lakhimpur, Sivasagar and Tinsukia in next 1-3 hours. Issued in Public Interest by ASDMA.
text_by_language.hi: Light Thunderstorms: IMD Guwahati has issued forecast for Light Thunderstorms with light to moderate rain which is very likely to occur at isolated places over Charaideo, Dhemaji, Dibrugarh, Lakhimpur, Sivasagar and Tinsukia in next 1-3 hours. Issued in Public Interest by ASDMA.
